subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's new disabled-by-default turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs config and timeout fence semantics as the canonical fix for deferred turn-maintenance stalls?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and well-proven, but choosing a new operator config and the exact timeout/fence policy is a maintainer product/compatibility decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept this opt-in timeout
options.body: Approve the new disabled-by-default config and fence semantics, then merge after the branch is refreshed against current main and checks stay green.

options.title: Reuse existing timeout policy
options.body: Ask for the fix to use an existing compaction safety timeout policy instead of adding a new config key, likely aligning with the alternative open PR approach.

options.title: Pause for policy consolidation
options.body: Hold this and the competing maintenance-timeout PRs until maintainers choose one canonical timeout/failure model for context-engine maintenance.
